focus: Managed Linux & AWS fleets, migrated ERPNext to Frappe Cloud (98% uptime), consolidated DNS into AWS Route 53 & Cloudflare, and established AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO).
highlights: Managed AWS and Linux servers supporting web applications, backends, and admin panels.
Deployed Frappe and ERPNext apps on Ubuntu servers via Docker; migrated ERPNext setup to Frappe Cloud (98% uptime, daily backups).
Consolidated multiple domains from GoDaddy/Hostinger to AWS Route 53 with dedicated environment hosted zones.
Configured Cloudflare DNS, DDoS protection, origin server security, and SSL/TLS encryption.
Managed multi-account AWS structure using AWS Organizations and AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO).
